'''Jeff Kolb''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Wheaton tournament]] on 28 May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], according to Paul Motz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d821">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-29-wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000d821/ wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 29 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-29-wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000d821/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
